source_evidence: To figure out how the costs of mutual fund classes add up over time and to compare the costs of different classes, you can use the FINRA Fund Analyzer.
question: Misconception: The FINRA Fund Analyzer automatically tells you which mutual fund share class is best for you. What’s the correction?
answer: The source describes the FINRA Fund Analyzer as a way to compare share-class costs over time. It does not say the tool chooses a suitable class for you. The source says class selection should also take your circumstances and investment goals into account.
